title: Hearty Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A fatty and pillowy Moroccan dish featuring chicken cooked in a flavorful sauce with sherry vinegar, perfect for a kid-friendly dinner
instructions: Cut the chicken into 1 1/2 inch pieces and season with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the chicken on all sides
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Add the sherry vinegar, chicken broth, and browned chicken to the skillet and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the tagine for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through
Prepare a bamboo steamer by lining it with large leaves such as cabbage or collard greens
Place the cooked tagine in the bamboo steamer and steam for 10 minutes or until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is very tender
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs such as parsley or cilantro
